overview.description: Launch Pad is a commercial family strategy card game where players construct rockets and score completed launches.

history.origins: Designed by Melanie James and published by Stratus Games in 2010, Launch Pad uses cards for rocket parts, experts, actions, and a four-card launch-pad game clock.

rules.objective: Score the most points from completed rockets after the launch pad timer ends.
rules.gameplay: Players draw and play rocket, metal, fuel, expert, astronaut, oxygen, certificate, security, and action cards, advancing rockets through construction, quality control, and launch preparation.
keyRules: Players build rockets through three production phases.
Resources and experts are required to advance rockets.
Four launch-pad cards create the game clock.
Final rocket points decide the winner.

strategy.basic: Build rockets that can actually pass every production phase; extra parts do not score if the rocket cannot launch.
strategy.intermediate: Track the cards, suits, or resources that control the next legal plays, and avoid giving opponents a simple route to their scoring condition.
strategy.advanced: Use memory and tempo to force opponents into inefficient plays while preserving cards or resources that complete your own plan.
tips: Keep the win condition visible while choosing short-term plays.
Preserve flexible cards until they unlock a scoring or tempo advantage.
